summary: This note describes Gold Hill, a small unincorporated community in southeastern Rowan County, North Carolina, located near the Cabarrus County line. It sits near the Yadkin River and is served by U.S. Highway 52 and Old Beatty Ford Road. The note also states that gold was found in the town outside Salisbury in the 19th century.
one_line: Gold Hill is a small unincorporated community in southeastern Rowan County, North Carolina, known for 19th-century gold finds.
